newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn, soy values mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn, soy values mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB grain and soybean values were mostly steady in subdued activity ahead of the Christmas holiday week, export sources said.

In export news, Pakistan is slated in the market over the weekend for optional origin wheat, and there was market talk that Tunisia will be in the market soon for 100,000 tonnes of optional origin wheat.

Also, the Commodity Credit Corp said it would tender for 10,370 tonnes of U.S. bulk crude degummed soybean oil for donation to Peru. The delivery period was slated for February 3-18 and offers were requested by January 7.
